ModMetaData.name: Expeditions
ModMetaData.author: Bambaryła
ModMetaData.description:
Go looking for things instead of buying them.
Open the Expeditions window from any comms console. It shows your colony's own map: what is around you, a few opportunities at a time, coming and going. Pick one, put together a squad as they stand (gear, skills, bionics and traits all count, and every number is shown before you commit), and send them off. They are gone for the trip. What happens out there is rolled off-screen and comes home as a report: what they found, what they could carry, who got hurt, and who did not come back. Sometimes they find nothing.
[b]Rides[/b] - On foot: slow both ways, but quiet, so sneaking in counts. They carry only what they can. - Drop pods: fast there, used up, and they walk home. - Shuttle: fast both ways with room for a lot of loot. - Vehicles (with Vehicle Framework): faster than walking, with cargo room; armed vehicles sometimes help in a fight. Loud arrivals give the squad away.
[b]Prospecting[/b] Ask around on the comms for any item. The rarer and more advanced it is, the less likely anyone knows where to find it. The answer only changes every couple of days.
[b]Captives[/b] Colonists taken on an expedition, or kidnapped by raiders, are listed with who holds them. Plan a rescue: storm the camp or slip in and out.
[b]Quest sites from the DLCs[/b] Sites your DLCs put on the world map show up on the board too, so a squad can do them instead of a caravan: - Ideology work sites: the squad brings back up to 60% of the stash. - Royalty outposts and mech clusters carrying a sun blocker, psychic droner or other machine: destroy it and the effect ends. - Biotech's ancient mechanitor complex (with its mechlink) and Ideology's ancient complexes. - Odyssey's gravcore sites, ancient structures (warehouse, chemfuel refinery, garrison, launch site, infested settlement), ancient mercenaries and the alpha thrumbo. A win brings back the whole prize. A partial win does too, but whoever held the site raids your colony soon after. Fail at a prize site and it is lost; fail at a harmful one and it stays for another try. Sites in orbit aren't included.
[b]Other mods[/b] - Vehicle Framework: vehicles as a ride; armed ones can help in a fight. - [LFS] UI Rethemed: the Expeditions window is drawn in its theme. - Combat Extended: adds an ammunition dump to raid. All of them are optional.
Squads need food for the whole trip.
